target_df.definition: Distinct target entity count by (country, token), computed separately for normalized name and normalized address tokens across S2 and S3.

candidate_score_fields.score: sum(1.0 / target_df(token)) over shared eligible tokens in the active token pass
candidate_score_fields.shared_token_count: count of shared distinct eligible tokens in the active token pass
candidate_score_fields.coverage_s1: shared_token_count / distinct active-field S1 token count
candidate_score_fields.coverage_target: shared_token_count / distinct active-field target token count
candidate_score_fields.token_jaccard: shared_token_count / (S1 token count + target token count - shared_token_count)
candidate_score_fields.exact_name: exact equality of non-empty frozen normalized name
candidate_score_fields.exact_address: exact equality of non-empty frozen normalized address
candidate_score_fields.postal_shared: equal non-empty first 5-6 digit sequence extracted from frozen normalized address
candidate_score_fields.numeric_shared: equal non-empty first numeric sequence extracted from frozen normalized address
candidate_score_fields.both_pass: candidate is present in both the name-token and address-token top-200-per-source shortlists

null_handling.exact_and_numeric_flags: false when the required non-empty value is absent
null_handling.coverage_and_jaccard: NULL only when a denominator is zero; DuckDB default DESC NULLS LAST applies
null_handling.target_entity_id: non-null by frozen input integrity contract

source_handling: Source identifier is excluded from identity evidence. It is used only to calculate per-source ranks and enforce policy quotas.
